$comment: RevealUI audit-remediation as-never-values validator allowlist. The two pre-existing broken audit_log writers (apps/admin/src/app/api/setup/route.ts and scripts/admin/bootstrap.ts) that used event/actor/meta columns cast `as never` were FIXED in Stage 1 (GAP-355): both now write the real audit_log columns (id/event_type/severity/agent_id/payload) with no `as never`, so their allowlist entries are removed. New `as never` on a drizzle .values() call fails CI unless a new entry with a reason is added here.
